title: The Delve
hook: **Vision:** a party crawl through seeded rooms toward a boss — haul out or fail trying. Not finished / not playable yet.

blindSpots.meaning: Locked fiction. You cannot enter a delve in the current loop.
A stage you travel to — room graph, pack, extract — not an expedition and not a lawn match.
A named place you find in the world, then enter from the Sanctum.
Delve is a stage (you go there to act). Almanac is a layer (opens over where you already are).

alsoTrue: Expeditions stay the idle sibling — delves do not replace them.
Interactive battles you play yourself are WIP shared with delves; formations and oaths are Vision depth.

sections.title: Not finished / not playable yet
paras: Sanctum, Lawn, World, and expeditions are where play lives today.
This page keeps the dungeon-crawler fantasy in the catalog until it ships.

sections.title: What it is (design)
paras: You find domains out in the world (expedition discoveries are part of that story). From the Sanctum you pick a found domain and enter.
Inside: a room graph — fights, elites, caches, shrines, merchants, traps, wild talk. You manage a pack. You extract with a haul — or you wipe.
diagram: find domain  ->  Sanctum enter  ->  room graph
sections.note: Unlock (when it ships): first domain found on an expedition.

doTitle: What you do with this page
doSteps: Do not hunt for a Delve button on the live rail — it is Vision.
Keep expeditions as the async crawl-adjacent loop that ships today.
When domains appear later, enter from the Sanctum and expect a return there when the run resolves.
doNote: Stop when delve ≠ expedition. Related: [pack, extract, oaths](pack-extract-oaths).

mixUps.q: Can I enter a delve today?
mixUps.a: No. Not finished / not playable yet.

mixUps.q: Is this just a long expedition?
mixUps.a: No. Expeditions auto-resolve idle. Delves are a presence stage with rooms and extract.
Design: find a domain, then enter from the Sanctum — when it ships.
